Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Date: 15 Jan 2025 | Facility: Amsterdam UMC (VUmc)

Clinical Indication:
Assessment prompted by sustained prostatic antigen levels at 12.0 ng/mL alongside a previous PI-RADS 5 designation. Indication centers on ruling out clinically significant disease.

FINDINGS:
Glandular dimensions total 32.82 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus, roughly 14 × 12 mm, situated within the left mid-gland peripheral zone. DWI shows pronounced diffusion restriction, mirrored by low ADC signal. Dynamic contrast phases capture early, localized enhancement against adjacent parenchyma. Capsular boundaries remain intact; seminal vesicles show no invasion. Neurovascular bundles are preserved. Pelvic lymph nodes demonstrate no suspicious features.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left mid-gland peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 32.82 mL; PSA density 0.366 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.86149156.
